name: Cascaded 2-way Merge for Global Splat Sorting
definition: A GPU-based algorithm to merge sorted splat lists from multiple active renderers into a single globally sorted order buffer using a cascaded binary merge tree.
summary: Cascaded 2-way Merge is a GPU algorithm that merges pre-sorted splat lists from multiple renderers into a single globally depth-sorted order, reducing overdraw and improving sorting accuracy across unified scenes.
